title: AirGC-CD: Gaussian-Circulant Precoding for Exactly Debiasable PAPR Reduction in Over-the-Air Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.23084v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Over-the-air federated learning lets edge devices transmit their local updates simultaneously, reducing the communication overhead. The resulting waveform, however, has a peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) that grows with the model dimension, and keeping the amplifier in its linear range leaves two remedies: clipping the peaks or backing off the transmit power. Neither remedy is without cost: i) the clipping distortion appears at the receiver as a bias that cannot be removed, and ii) back-off keeps the signal intact but degrades the average signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Independent of this trade-off, the transmission remains uncompressed, spending one channel use per model parameter, which keeps large-model training out of reach. To address these challenges, we propose AirGC-CD, an over-the-air scheme that precodes each local update with a partial Gaussian circulant matrix before clipping. In AirGC-CD, the precoder's output is exactly Gau

translated_title: AirGC-CD：用于空中联邦学习中可精确去偏PAPR降低的高斯-循环预编码
translated_abstract: 空中联邦学习让边缘设备能够同时传输各自的本地更新，从而降低通信开销。然而，由此产生的波形具有随模型维度增长的峰均功率比（PAPR），而要将放大器保持在其线性范围内只有两种补救手段：削峰或回退发射功率。但这两种方法都并非没有代价：i) 削波失真在接收端表现为无法消除的偏差；ii) 功率回退虽能保持信号完整，却会降低平均信噪比（SNR）。与这一权衡无关的是，传输本身仍是无压缩的，每个模型参数都要消耗一次信道使用，这使得大模型训练难以实现。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了AirGC-CD，这是一种空中传输方案，它在削波之前用部分高斯循环矩阵对每个本地更新进行预编码。在AirGC-CD中，预编码器的输出恰好是高斯……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出AirGC-CD方案，通过在削波前用部分高斯循环矩阵对本地更新进行预编码，在空中联邦学习中实现可精确去偏的PAPR降低，同时兼顾压缩传输与SNR性能。
en_tdlr: AirGC-CD introduces Gaussian-circulant precoding before clipping to achieve exactly debiasable PAPR reduction in over-the-air federated learning, while simultaneously enabling compressed transmission and preserving SNR performance.
